Treasury Laws Amendment (Financial Market Infrastructure and Other Measures) Act 2024

The Coalition senator argued the Safeguard Mechanism bill and the Labor-Greens deal would increase costs for households and businesses, citing potential rate rises for Perth's Red Hill Waste Management Facility, higher fuel prices from Ampol's Lytton refinery, and increased V/Line train fares, while criticising the government for not consulting the 215 covered facilities on specific impacts or ruling out job losses.

Argued that letting the Stronger Futures in the Northern Territory Act 2012 lapse increased alcohol-related harm, citing a 54 per cent rise in assaults, and supported the Northern Territory Safe Measures Bill 2023 to restore restrictions. Others opposed the bill as unnecessary and racist, saying the Northern Territory has sufficient legislative means, while the government said federal intervention was not the right step.

The speaker argued that the Referendum (Machinery Provisions) Amendment Bill 2022 removes essential safeguards for the Voice referendum, including the requirement for an official pamphlet outlining both cases and the establishment of equally funded official "yes" and "no" campaign organisations, which they said would undermine voter information and integrity while risking foreign interference.
